column1: # OLMoE-1B-7B residency re-measured with gate mass preserved. The published numbers used gate_mass=renorm, which on a norm_topk_prob=False model raises the top-k gate mass from ~0.40 to 1.0 and scales every MoE block output by ~2.5x over 16 layers. 'renorm' rows reproduce the published intervention; 'preserve' rows select from the masked distribution but weight from the unmasked one. free_baseline 0.670290. Producer: analysis/residency/olmoe_remeasure.py
